newsitem.title: UK: Queen Elizabeth's press secretary Anson resigns.
newsitem.headline: Queen Elizabeth's press secretary Anson resigns.

text.p: Queen Elizabeth's press secretary, Charles Anson, is to resign in January, Buckingham Palace said on Monday.

Anson, who has been the British monarch's press secretary since 1990, will be succeeded by Geoffrey Crawford, an Australian citizen. Anson, 52, will become group corporate relations director at Grand Metropolitan Plc.
